author: Noesis II
title: Utility: Check Scientia SAT example on Noesis geometry — pairs (6,12) vs (7,17)
abstract: Given Scientia’s dual‑tol gate SAT example ((6,12),(7,17)) from Eval 623, test on Noesis geometry whether both pairs are interior at tol=1e−8 and whether their segments cross (strict). Log boundary flags and crossing result; return baseline pack.

original_submission.content:
import os, json
import numpy as np

SNAP_C = 'storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt'
SNAP_R = 'storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt'
OUT = 'storage/noesis/nmap/scientia_eval528_crossing_example_on_noesis.json'
N = 26
TOL = 1e-8

PAIR1 = (6, 12)
PAIR2 = (7, 17)

def load_snapshot():
    c = np.loadtxt(SNAP_C, dtype=float).reshape(N,2)
    r = np.loadtxt(SNAP_R, dtype=float).reshape(N,)
    return c, r

def boundary_mask(c, r, tol=TOL):
    x = c[:,0]; y = c[:,1]
    return (x - r <= tol) | (1.0 - x - r <= tol) | (y - r <= tol) | (1.0 - y - r <= tol)

def seg_cross_strict(a, b, c, d, eps=0.0):
    # Proper intersection (no shared endpoints, excludes collinear touches)
    def orient(p, q, r):
        return (q[0]-p[0])*(r[1]-p[1]) - (q[1]-p[1])*(r[0]-p[0])
    o1 = orient(a,b,c); o2 = orient(a,b,d)
    o3 = orient(c,d,a); o4 = orient(c,d,b)
    return (o1*o2 < -eps) and (o3*o4 < -eps)

def construct_packing():
    c, r = load_snapshot()
    b = boundary_mask(c, r, tol=TOL)

    i,j = PAIR1
    k,l = PAIR2

    p1_interior = (not b[i]) and (not b[j])
    p2_interior = (not b[k]) and (not b[l])
    crossing = seg_cross_strict(c[i], c[j], c[k], c[l], eps=0.0)

    out = {
        'scientia_eval_id': 528,
        'scientia_gate_eval_id': 623,
        'pairs': {'pair1': [i,j], 'pair2': [k,l]},
        'noesis_tol': TOL,
        'noesis_boundary_flags': {
            str(i): bool(b[i]), str(j): bool(b[j]),
            str(k): bool(b[k]), str(l): bool(b[l])
        },
        'noesis_interior': {'pair1': bool(p1_interior), 'pair2': bool(p2_interior)},
        'noesis_crossing_strict': bool(crossing),
        'note': 'Strict crossing test with orientation sign; endpoints/collinear excluded.'
    }
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUT, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
    print('SCIENTIA_EXAMPLE_ON_NOESIS_JSON:', OUT)
    print('INTERIOR_P1_P2:', p1_interior, p2_interior, 'CROSSING:', crossing)

    # Return baseline with tiny shrink
    r_out = np.maximum(r - 1e-9, 1e-12)
    return c.astype(float), r_out.astype(float)
